prefectures.label: Miyagi
prefectures.source_title: 宮城県 令和8年度クマ目撃等情報
prefectures.method_note: Same series as the ministry's table for FY2025 (3,559 total). The page prints 0 for every month not yet reached (September to March as of 2026-09-02); those are stored here as blank, not zero.

prefectures.label: Yamagata
prefectures.source_title: ツキノワグマ月別目撃件数（山形県、8.30現在）
prefectures.method_note: Prefecture-wide 目撃 (visual sighting) counts, Table 1 令和8年 column; footnote excludes human-injury cases and track/trace-only reports. September blank in the source (cumulative unchanged at 869). FY2025 Apr-Sep on the same page (35,134,278,351,277,375) equals the MoE FY2025 row. The source's own summary box says 8月累計 R7=267 while its table cell reads 277; the table value is the one MoE carries.

prefectures.label: Fukushima
prefectures.source_title: 福島県クマ目撃マップ (Excel 市町村別集計 758443.xlsx, sheet R0８情報提供資料)
prefectures.method_note: Labelled クマ目撃件数 but the underlying police log mixes 目撃, 交通事故, 足跡等痕跡, 傷害, 列車事故 and their sum reproduces the monthly totals, i.e. an all-incident count; same method in FY2025, whose row (29,93,172,188,179,187,...,2047) equals the MoE FY2025 row exactly. July covers only 1-15 July (published 2026-07-28), so July is incomplete.

prefectures.label: Niigata
prefectures.source_title: にいがたクマ出没マップ (ArcGIS FeatureServer behind the 新潟県 ツキノワグマ出没情報 page); FY2025 check: suii_496555.pdf
prefectures.method_note: Records tagged 目撃 / 痕跡 / 人身 summed together (FY2026 to date 554+78+2=634). Day-by-day re-aggregation of FY2025 reproduces the prefecture PDF's R7 row and the MoE FY2025 row exactly (27,151,214,246,180,435,...,3528). MoE's own FY2026 June cell (213) is two records behind the live feed (215).

prefectures.label: Gunma
prefectures.source_title: クマの目撃・出没情報、人身被害情報（群馬県）
prefectures.method_note: 県内のクマの目撃・出没件数 in human living areas, 令和8年度 row; 人身被害 tracked in a separate table. FY2025 row (20,52,103,109,109,117,519,289,57,13,5,5 = 1,398) equals the MoE FY2025 row. MoE's FY2026 June cell (231) differs from the prefecture page's 215; the prefecture page is used here.

prefectures.label: Nagano
prefectures.source_title: 長野県のツキノワグマ目撃及び人身被害の状況（令和８年９月４日現在）
prefectures.method_note: 人の生活圏でのツキノワグマの目撃件数の推移（速報値）: sightings in human living areas only, forest-interior sightings and 人身被害 excluded; forestry-department tally. FY2025 row equals the MoE FY2025 row (25,59,226,200,183,176,219,174,42,9,4,7).

prefectures.label: Gifu
prefectures.source_title: 岐阜県に生息するクマ（ツキノワグマ）について（自然環境課）
prefectures.format: cumulative only (one sentence on the page)
prefectures.method_note: No monthly table. Page states 令和8年度の岐阜県内でのクマ目撃件数は、525件です（令和8年8月16日時点）: FY2026 cumulative 525 sightings (目撃 only, narrower than MoE's 出没 series) from 2026-04-01 to 2026-08-16. No FY2025 figure on the page, so comparability with MoE could not be checked.

prefectures.label: Toyama
prefectures.source_title: 令和8年度 富山県ツキノワグマ出没警報（第4報）
prefectures.method_note: No monthly table; the bulletin gives a running FY total only: 222 出没 (目撃・痕跡) from April to 2026-07-30 (147 to 2026-06-26 in the 第3報). Its comparison figures match the MoE FY2025 row (昨年7月末 161 = 10+25+58+68), so the series is the same as MoE's, but no month value can be filled.

prefectures.label: Fukui
prefectures.source_title: 福井県内のツキノワグマの出没状況（令和4年度〜令和8年度）
prefectures.method_note: 県全域 row of クマの出没（目撃・痕跡・捕獲・人身被害）件数: sightings + traces + captures + injuries. The R8 row prints 0 for September onward as an empty template, stored here as blank. FY2025 row equals the MoE FY2025 row (35,90,115,102,40,62,204,216,53,19,10,4 = 950).

prefectures.label: Shimane
prefectures.source_title: 島根県：クマの出没・被害状況と出没予測（ツキノワグマの目撃等件数、令和8年7月31日現在）
prefectures.method_note: 目撃等件数: sightings plus 痕跡, 被害 and 捕獲等, one continuous table FY2014-FY2026. FY2025 row equals the MoE FY2025 row (23,135,124,150,85,55,104,113,60,17,7,18 = 891). FY2026 total printed 765 = 94+285+218+168.

prefectures.label: Hiroshima
prefectures.source_title: 県内におけるツキノワグマの月別目撃件数（広島県 wildlife-management portal）
prefectures.method_note: Suspected sightings and traces included, 人身被害 excluded. Portal says 令和８年度は7月末時点の情報. FY2025 row equals the MoE FY2025 row (21,44,76,64,42,46,107,125,47,10,3,7 = 592).

prefectures.label: Hyogo
prefectures.source_title: 第３回 兵庫県ツキノワグマ対策連絡会議 資料（令和8年6月15日）クマの目撃・痕跡件数
prefectures.method_note: Sightings + traces, 人身被害 separate. FY2025 row equals the MoE FY2025 row (39,121,53,80,49,59,45,32,12,10,3,7 = 510). MoE's own FY2026 row already shows 33,117,158 through June, i.e. Hyogo revised May by one and added June after this meeting; a newer Hyogo source is needed for June onward.

prefectures.label: Yamaguchi
prefectures.source_title: 令和8年度 市町別、月別クマ目撃情報（山口県自然保護課、令和8年9月4日時点）
prefectures.method_note: 目撃 count compiled from municipal reports; captures shown as an of-which sub-row, traces and 人身被害 not included. FY2025 from fy2025-monthly-by-city.pdf equals the MoE FY2025 row (17,40,26,58,47,25,76,77,30,9,1,2 = 408).

prefectures.label: Ishikawa
prefectures.source_title: ツキノワグマ目撃件数（R8.9.2時点）石川県
prefectures.method_note: Sighting tally by municipality and month reported through the regional agricultural/forestry offices; 痕跡 (14) listed separately and not included. The itemised list has 191 records, last dated 2026-08-29, so September reads 0 as of 2026-09-02. Ishikawa frames its own prior-year table by calendar year; Apr-Dec FY2025 equals the MoE FY2025 row (9,30,97,47,30,13,91,53,13).

prefectures.label: Yamanashi
prefectures.source_title: 近年のツキノワグマ出没・目撃及び捕獲状況（令和8年9月4日16時現在）
prefectures.method_note: 目撃件数 under 出没・目撃状況; captured animals excluded (separate 捕獲状況 table). FY2025 row equals the MoE FY2025 row (4,24,70,52,42,22,33,62,28,5,4,6 = 352). MoE's FY2026 June cell (52) is one behind this PDF (53).

prefectures.label: Tochigi
prefectures.source_title: 令和８年度のクマ出没（目撃）状況（栃木県）
prefectures.method_note: 目撃件数（新聞報道等を集計）: sightings tabulated from newspaper reports, traces and 人身被害 not included. Page footer says 令和８年６月30日現在 but the June cell is still blank. FY2025 row equals the MoE FY2025 row (3,29,27,49,46,31,47,36,15,9,5,8 = 305).

mast.index_definition: 区分 / 開花（結実）状況 / 豊凶指数: 全体 樹冠全体にたくさんの花（実）がついている ５; 部分 樹冠上部に多くの花（実）がついている ３; 一部 ごくわずかに花（実）がついている １; 非開花（非結実） まったく花（実）がついていない ０. 結実予測は、各調査箇所の調査結果を数値化、集計し豊凶指数を算出して、下表のとおり結実の豊凶を推測します。 豊凶指数 3.5以上 豊作 / 2.0以上3.5未満 並作 / 1.0以上2.0未満 凶作 / 1.0未満 大凶作. 注：豊凶指数1.0未満でも一部に開花・結実が見られる場合もあり、誤解を避けるため、平成29年度から豊凶区分の「皆無」を「大凶作」に変更しました。 (東北森林管理局. The prefecture index is the mean of the per-point scores over the points surveyed that year.)
